verdict.rationale: Docs say SmartScan reads merchant, date, total and currency in realtime, and that expenses can be categorized and tagged by plain-language request, with multi-level GL coding, rules, imported corporate cards and automatic export to QuickBooks Online or NetSuite. That covers capturing and coding spend at the point of purchase. Hands-on community reports undercut automatic coding quality: categorization reportedly wrong about 70% of the time unless obvious, and receipt processing took about 20 minutes rather than realtime, so finance may still have to correct codes at close. Missing for 10: evidence that memos are captured at the point of spend, independent confirmation that categorization is accurate, and recent hands-on corroboration that coding is complete before close.
